shortDescription: Manage the HPE Nimble Storage Replication Partner

options.name: control_port
options.description: Port number of partner control interface. Value -1 for an invalid port or a positive integer value up to 65535 representing the TCP/IP port.

options.name: data_port
options.description: Port number of partner data interface. Value -1 for an invalid port or a positive integer value up to 65535 representing the TCP/IP port.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of replication partner.

options.name: downstream_hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of partner interface. This must be the partner's Group Management IP address. String of up to 64 alphanumeric characters, - and . and ':' are allowed after first character.

options.name: folder
options.description: The Folder ID within the pool where volumes replicated from this partner will be created. This is not supported for pool partners.

options.name: host
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage IP address.

options.name: match_folder
options.description: Indicates whether to match the upstream volume's folder on the downstream.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of replication partner. String of up to 64 alphanumeric characters, - and . and  ':' are allowed after first character.

options.name: password
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage password.

options.name: pause
options.description: Pause replication for the specified partner.

options.name: pool
options.description: The pool name where volumes replicated from this partner will be created. Replica volumes created as clones ignore this parameter and are always created in the same pool as their parent volume.

options.name: repl_data_hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of partner data interface. String of up to 64 alphanumeric characters, - and . and ':' are allowed after first character.

options.name: resume
options.description: Resume replication for the specified partner.

options.name: secret
options.description: Replication partner shared secret, used for mutual authentication of the partners.

options.name: state
options.description: The replication partner operation.

options.name: subnet_label
options.description: Indicates whether to match the upstream volume's folder on the downstream.

options.name: subnet_type
options.description: Type of the subnet used to replicate to this partner.

options.name: test
options.description: Test connectivity to the specified partner.

options.name: throttles
options.description: Throttles used while replicating from/to this partner. All the throttles for the partner.

options.name: username
options.description: HPE Nimble Storage user name.
